features.label: General / top-level

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Guard AudioCallbackDriver::mAudioStream with a DataMutex.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Part 3: Record Audio Session API adoption telemetry.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Part 1: Define the media.audio_session and media.audio_focus Glean metrics.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Bound the conversion source read to the mapped surface size in the image conversion helpers.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Validate input video frame dimensions before conversion in the encoder path.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Constrain the picture rectangle to the image buffer when building a video frame.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Reset the picture region when the decoder adopts a new image size from the stream.

features.summary: Browserside media plumbing got a round of robustness and telemetry work: Firefox now records adoption and focus metrics for the Audio Session API (via Glean) so engineers can understand how sites use audio sessions, and various video-path checks were tightened to validate frame dimensions and constrain picture rectangles during conversion and encoding. These changes reduce crashes and visual corruption by preventing out-of-bounds image reads and by resetting picture regions when streams change. _No visible UI changes for most users, but playback is more stable._

features.label: Decoder / platform backends

patches.author: Tymur Boiko
patches.subject: DOM Media - Add FFmpeg 63 support.

patches.author: Tymur Boiko
patches.subject: Fix fallback for Vulkan Video VP9 decoding.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Synchronize access to the CDM proxy state.

patches.author: Tymur Boiko
patches.subject: Restore the NVIDIA block-linear modifier with a reduced block height.

features.summary: Platform decoders were updated for compatibility and stability: support for a newer FFmpeg release was added, Vulkan-based video decoding (including VP9) has improved fallbacks and NVIDIA memory-layout handling was tuned, and access to DRM/CDM proxy state was synchronized to avoid race conditions. Together these fixes make hardware-accelerated video playback and protected (DRM) content decoding more reliable across GPUs and driver setups.

features.label: Media Control / Session

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Part 5: Add browser-chrome tests for the media.audio_session and media.audio_focus probes.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Part 2: Record audio-session arbitration and interrupt telemetry in the parent.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Hold a transiently interrupted audio session across the suspension it causes.

features.summary: The media session and audio-focus code now records richer telemetry for the Audio Session API and audio-arbitration events, and browser tests were added to validate those probes. Behavior around short interruptions (like transient audio interruptions) was improved so the session keeps its state across the suspension it causes, which helps audio apps resume smoothly after brief interruptions. **More consistent handling of audio interruptions** makes media playback and background audio behavior feel less jumpy to users.

features.label: Media IPC

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Improve shutdown handling for the media engine child actor.

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Only initialize the remote media engine once.

patches.author: alastor0325
patches.subject: Update asynchronous promise handling in MFCDMChild.

features.summary: Inter-process media plumbing received lifecycle and async fixes: the remote media engine is initialized exactly once and shutdown logic for the media engine child process was hardened to avoid leaks or races during teardown. Asynchronous promise handling for the CDM (the DRM child side) was also improved so DRM-related operations behave more predictably across process boundaries. These changes reduce crashes and race conditions when using encrypted media or when the media engine is started/stopped.

features.label: Tests

patches.author: Dan Masquelier
patches.subject: Do not present MP4 edit-list preroll before media start.

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Add a regression test for decoding and seeking a Blob read from CacheStorage.

patches.author: Paul Adenot
patches.subject: Add a regression test for playing a video from a Blob rebuilt from an ArrayBuffer.

features.summary: Several regression tests were added to make media playback from Blobs and cached data more reliable: tests ensure seeking and decoding work when a video is read from CacheStorage or rebuilt from an ArrayBuffer, and MP4 edit-list preroll behavior was fixed so preroll frames aren’t presented before playback starts. These tests protect cached and blob-based playback scenarios often used by service workers and web apps, improving reliability for offline and progressive-loading experiences.

features.label: Docs

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Part 2: Add security-review guidance to the dom/media review docs.

features.summary: Developer-facing documentation for DOM/media reviews now includes explicit security-review guidance. This helps code reviewers check for common security pitfalls when changing media code (for example, DRM, cross-origin handling, or buffer validations) so media changes get the right scrutiny before landing.

features.label: HTMLMediaElement

patches.author: Alastor Wu
patches.subject: Part 4: Record per-source interrupt resume.

features.summary: HTMLMediaElement was enhanced to record per-source interrupt-resume behavior, so the browser can tell when an individual media source resumes after an interruption. This telemetry helps engineers understand resume behavior for things like audio focus changes or short pauses, improving how the browser and sites coordinate playback recovery.

features.label: Mp3

patches.author: Sylvestre Ledru
patches.subject: Coverity CID 1697238: hoist AverageFrameLength() out of MP3TrackDemuxer::Duration

features.summary: A small internal refactor in the MP3 demuxer made the duration and frame-length calculation clearer and safer. The change reduces risk of subtle duration or overflow bugs in MP3 playback and satisfies static-analysis checks; it’s an internal stability improvement with no user-facing feature change.

features.label: Web Audio

patches.author: Mike Hommey
patches.subject: Add missing include for uint*_t.

features.summary: A build portability fix was applied to the Web Audio code by adding a missing integer-type include (uint*_t). This is a compilation/maintenance fix that ensures Web Audio builds cleanly across platforms; there’s no change in audio behavior for end users.
